rca of the issue: Parallel pytest lockout — pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. backend_test.py uses a session-scoped `token` fixture that logs in with the real admin password. test_security_and_features.py runs on the other worker and its lockout / wrong-password tests (against bogus_email + backup-email wrong-password + change-password happy path that temporarily changes admin pw) can leave admin with 1-4 failed attempts recorded on the shared MongoDB during the ~1s window before the session token fixture is created. Result: 401 with '4 percobaan tersisa'. Mitigation: (a) run serial with `-o addopts=`, (b) in conftest add a `db.login_attempts.delete_many({email:ADMIN_EMAIL})` before the login call in the session token fixture with 1 retry, (c) or run session token before other module tests using `pytest --dist loadfile` and a topmost autouse session fixture.
